sources.title: Piracy monthly report October 2024
sources.text: While underway, 6 perpetrators armed with knives were sighted in the engine room. They immediately entered the engine room and held the C/E, tied him with a rope and stole his personal belongings before escaping. His personal belongings, including a gold chain, tablet and mobile phone were robbed. The alarm was raised and crew mustered to conduct a search onboard the ship. No perpetrators were found. All crew members were accounted for. The crew was not injured. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS West.
